name: Worldpal
source:
The player and two mysterious girls are a trio get into a time loop, or cycles. They trying to figure out what is happening and why everything around them feels like a badly written script. But the deeper they get into it, the weirder it gets. Or does someone make it weirder?

You are part of this stupid story.

[From [url=https://karasiko.itch.io/worldpal-demo]itch.io[/url]]
